name: Bali
shortDescription: Terraced rice fields, temple sunsets and a coastline made for slow evenings.
description: Bali blends lush volcanic highlands, sculpted rice terraces and dramatic clifftop temples with a warm, creative island culture. Spend mornings among the paddies of Ubud, afternoons on the surf beaches of the Bukit Peninsula, and evenings watching the sun melt into the Indian Ocean from a temple ledge.
imageAlt: Palm trees silhouetted against a pink and orange sunset over the sea, with green terraced hillsides on the left
activities: Watch a sunset kecak dance at Uluwatu
Cycle through rice paddies near Ubud
travelTips: Hire a driver for day trips; traffic in the south is heavy
Dress modestly and carry a sarong for temple visits
Book Nusa Penida boat transfers a day ahead in peak season
Carry small cash for markets and warungs

name: Swiss Alps
shortDescription: Snow-crowned peaks, flower meadows and trains that glide through postcards.
description: The Swiss Alps pair monumental peaks with spotless villages, glacial lakes and one of the world's most scenic rail networks. Hike high meadows in summer, ski the same slopes in winter, and ride cogwheel trains to viewpoints where the glaciers glow at dawn.
imageAlt: Snow-capped alpine peaks above green meadows, pine forests and a small wooden chalet under a bright blue sky
bestTimeToVisit: June to September, December to March
activities: Take a lake cruise on Lake Lucerne
Taste fondue in a mountain hut
travelTips: A Swiss Travel Pass can lower rail and bus costs on longer trips
Pack layers; mountain weather changes within hours
Book summit trains early on clear-weather days
Switzerland is among the costliest destinations, so budget generously

name: Kyoto
shortDescription: Vermilion torii, quiet pagodas and cherry blossoms drifting over old streets.
description: Kyoto was Japan's capital for over a thousand years and still feels like its soul. Wander lantern-lit lanes in Gion, walk through endless torii gates at Fushimi Inari, sip matcha in a hidden tea house and see the city transform each spring beneath clouds of cherry blossom.
imageAlt: A red torii gate and a pagoda framed by pink cherry blossom branches in soft morning mist
bestTimeToVisit: March to May, October to November
activities: Walk the Fushimi Inari torii trail at dawn
Rent a kimono for a day in Higashiyama
travelTips: Visit famous shrines early to avoid crowds
Get an IC card for buses and trains
Cherry blossom dates shift each year, so check forecasts
Be quiet and respectful in Gion's residential lanes

name: Santorini
shortDescription: Whitewashed villages, blue domes and sunsets over a flooded volcano.
description: Santorini is the curved rim of an ancient volcano, crowned by whitewashed villages that cling to the caldera cliffs. Watch the sun set from Oia, taste crisp Assyrtiko wine on volcanic soil, sail across the caldera and swim from black-sand beaches.
imageAlt: White cube-shaped houses and blue domes stepping down a steep cliff beside a deep blue sea
activities: Hike the caldera path from Fira to Oia
travelTips: Reserve sunset dinner spots well in advance
Wear comfortable shoes; the villages are steep and stepped
Stay outside Oia for better value
Cruise ships crowd the towns midday, so explore early or late

name: Ladakh
shortDescription: High-altitude deserts, turquoise lakes and monasteries above the clouds.
description: Ladakh is a high-altitude desert of stark ridgelines, turquoise lakes and whitewashed Buddhist monasteries strung with prayer flags. Drive over some of the world's highest motorable passes, camp beside Pangong Tso and spend evenings with butter tea in a Himalayan village.
imageAlt: Prayer flags stretched toward a white stupa beside a turquoise lake beneath snow-capped Himalayan ridges
climate: Cool, thin air, 5–25°C by day in summer
activities: Ride a Bactrian camel in Hunder dunes
travelTips: Spend two days acclimatising in Leh before going higher
Drink plenty of water and avoid alcohol on arrival
Carry cash; ATMs are unreliable outside Leh
Check road and permit status for restricted areas

name: Kerala
shortDescription: Quiet backwaters, spice hills and coconut-fringed canals at a gentle pace.
description: Kerala is a tapestry of palm-lined backwaters, mist-covered tea hills and spice-scented forests. Drift through Alleppey's canals on a traditional houseboat, wander Munnar's tea estates, and finish with fresh seafood and a coastal Ayurvedic massage.
imageAlt: A thatched houseboat on a calm green backwater lined with tall coconut palms
activities: Overnight on a houseboat in Alleppey
Watch a Kathakali performance in Kochi
travelTips: Avoid the heaviest monsoon months for houseboat trips
Choose licensed houseboat operators
Carry light cotton clothing and insect repellent
Book Munnar stays early in peak season

name: Cappadocia
shortDescription: Fairy chimneys, cave hotels and hot-air balloons drifting at sunrise.
description: Cappadocia's volcanic valleys are filled with soft-stone chimneys, cave dwellings and underground cities. Float over the landscape in a sunrise balloon, hike rose-coloured canyons and sleep in a hotel carved into the rock.
imageAlt: Colourful hot-air balloons rising over rock chimneys in a warm orange sunrise sky
bestTimeToVisit: April to June, September to November
activities: Take a sunrise hot-air balloon flight
Hike Rose Valley at golden hour
Join a pottery workshop in Avanos
travelTips: Balloon flights are weather-dependent, so keep a spare morning
Book flights with licensed operators well in advance
Wear grippy shoes for rocky trails
Rent an ATV or scooter for flexible valley exploring

name: Maldives
shortDescription: Overwater villas, glassy lagoons and reefs just beyond your deck.
description: The Maldives is a scatter of low coral islands ringed by luminous lagoons and thriving reefs. Sleep in an overwater villa, snorkel with turtles right off the deck, dive with manta rays and spend the evenings on a private sandbank beneath a sky full of stars.
imageAlt: A wooden jetty leading to thatched overwater villas across a bright turquoise lagoon
activities: Stay a few nights on a local island
travelTips: Resort islands are pricey; local-island guesthouses cost far less
Confirm seaplane transfer schedules before booking
Pack reef-safe sunscreen
Check dress and alcohol rules on local islands
